parsed.name: 海洋光谱仪
parsed.description: 海洋光谱仪是一类用于测量光强随波长分布的实验室光谱设备，常用于采集样品的发射、透射、反射或其他光学光谱信号。该类仪器适合基础光谱测量、过程监测和通用光学实验。
parsed.description_en: An ocean spectrometer is a laboratory optical spectrometer used to measure light intensity as a function of wavelength. It is commonly used to acquire emission, transmission, reflection, or other optical spectra from samples in general spectroscopy experiments and routine measurement workflows.
